thread:
trent: Hey — confidential heads-up. I need to pick up my kid from daycare unexpectedly for the next 2 weeks (medical closure). Can we arrange a temporary shift adjustment and on-call coverage? I don’t want this posted broadly.
maria (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, @trent. Sorry to hear that — we can help. Can you DM the preferred daily window you need? We’ll treat this confidentially and suggest options (flex start, shorter days, swap on-call). :heart:
jordan (Manager): I can cover trent’s late-afternoon pairing sessions on Mon/Wed this week. Happy to swap some of my async tasks. How many late days are we talking about?
trent: Appreciate it, @jordan. It’s pickup around 4:30–5:30pm each weekday for two weeks, so I’d prefer shifting my core hours earlier (8:30–5) and be off the late slot. Also hoping for exemption from the late-night pager rotation for the period.
maria (People Ops): That sounds reasonable. Two quick steps: 1) We’ll log a confidential temporary accommodation request so it’s documented; 2) Confirm coverage plan with your manager (already in thread). I’ll draft the accommodation note and share it only with HR and your manager.
peopleops_bot: Reminder: If you want formal documentation for payroll or on-call exemptions, please submit the "Temporary Schedule Accommodation" form: https://redwood.internal/forms/temp-schedule (this will only be visible to HR/manager).
jordan (Manager): Draft coverage plan: I’ll take the 4:30–6pm pairing on Mon/Wed; @alex can we rotate Fri async reviews? Trent, if you can shift to 8:30–5 that should keep SLAs. If anyone else needs a swap, ping me.
trent: That plan works. I’ll DM @maria the dates and confirm the nights I need pager off. Thanks for keeping this tight and confidential.
maria (People Ops): Got the DM with dates. I opened a confidential accommodation entry and set the end date for two weeks with a 1-week check-in. I’ll email the accommodation note to you and jordan only. If you need to extend, we can re-evaluate and discuss backup coverage.
trent: Perfect. Also want to confirm this won’t affect my performance review — just making sure a short-term accommodation doesn’t change expectations.
maria (People Ops): Confirmed — temporary schedule accommodations are not a negative signal for performance. We’ll coordinate any task reassignment with your manager; expectations and goals remain the same unless explicitly changed. If you want, we can add a private note to your review file that clarifies the accommodation period.
trent: Thank you. Really helps.
jordan (Manager): Thanks all. I’ll update the team calendar and set the pairing swaps. If anything urgent pops up outside 5pm, page me and I’ll handle it for two weeks. :thumbsup:
peopleops_bot: Action logged: confidential-accommodation-created by maria for trent (start: 2187654400, end: 2188269200). Notification only to HR and manager.
trent: Appreciate it — closing the loop here. Will reach out if we need to extend.
